metadata-only-discipline-load-stock.head: d0821347
metadata-only-discipline-load-stock.scope: Stock mode ability-parity-metadata-rows. At login the only record among the seven rows was source 75 stat 1055 +25, and the stock Status Bonuses tab listed Debuff Area Radius Bonus +65%, a total that includes that +25. No record came from 18, 397, 537, 538, 539 or 1199. ?qaunload and ?qaload of 397, 1199 and 539 were each acknowledged (Unloaded/Loaded 1 abilities; memory 52 to 53 for 397 and 539, unchanged at 53 for the cost-0 1199) with no [MODIFIER] record added or removed and no Bonuses change.

consumer.source: GOB 18 stores no StatModifier, grant, TestFunction or CastingScript. It is the DisciplineBelongsTo parent of 24, 27, 30, 36, 37, 970 and 1008, and 23 and 276 require it. Shipped crafting_server.py CoderApplication(subject, invItem, buffValue) has no caller: no script, no string field in any of the 44,406 GOB templates and no client.dll string names it.
consumer.runtime: AbilityPassives publishes nothing for 18 and AbilityProgression grants nothing. Its children load as their own rows, and the server invents no buffValue for the unreachable CoderApplication.
consumer.test: CosmeticRowResolutionTests.MetadataOnlyRowsAuthorNoModifierGrantCallbackOrExecutor: the row has no modifier, grant, aura, buff, temp-mod, pet, utility, test, script or tool executor, and loading it changes none of the stats the catalog names. Native load and Archive check: NativeQa mode ability-parity-metadata-rows.

stats.source: GOB 75 stores one while-enabled modifier: 1055 Debuff Area Radius Bonus, learned-level function 2 with scale 0.5, so +25 at 50. 1055 reaches the radius only through 177 AbilityAttributeLink. That link uses 177's own owner coefficient, which the native getter 622ffce0 zero-fills (ABILITY-DEBUFF-RADIUS.md, Initial linked-attribute default).
stats.runtime: AbilityPassives publishes the 1055 total and record. AbilityRadius.TargetMetres reads direct 177 only, so the UDB0 radius does not change.
stats.test: CosmeticRowResolutionTests.ResistInfectionPublishesOnly1055AndLeavesEveryDebuffRadiusUnchanged: the only change is 1055 +25, 177 stays 0, and the 333/38/60/97 radii are unchanged. AbilityPassiveTests.DirectDebuffRadiusUsesCaster177WhileUnproven75LinkStaysExcluded covers the same boundary. Stock witness for a loaded 1055 passive that leaves the radius unchanged: https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/1056#issuecomment-7121743549

stats.source: GOB 161 stores one while-enabled modifier: 577 Sneak Attack Detection, learned-level function 2 with scale 4.0 and rank cap 10, so +40. Template 577 has no AttributeLink. The only shipped reader is BaseSneakAttackDepAttr in ability/spy/sneaks.py. BaseSneakAttackTestFn declares that dependency but sets SUCCESS without reading it.
stats.runtime: AbilityPassives publishes the 577 total and record. No server path reads 577, and SpyAbilityRegistry sneak opener admission ignores the target total, as the shipped test does.
stats.test: CosmeticRowResolutionTests.UncannySensesPublishesOnlySneakAttackDetectionAtItsRankCap (only 577 +40, detection 204 unchanged) and SneakOpenerAdmissionIgnoresTheTargetsSneakAttackDetection (Suplex 287 and Diving Frankensteiner 385 rear admission succeeds with and without the target's 161). Stock removal and restoration of source 161's +40: https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/480
